Owner decision. Adults alone take Version A (Wilcox Pass); its 12:30 start is the split-day time that fits inside the family's Ice Explorer block, so with the 07:30 day start the adults wait 3 h 20 at the trailhead. Data is not wrong for the split; the fix is the builder's split-day start-time back-calculation (DATA-PLAN 2.4 DG-03 code half). Not changed.

S2D-TIME. 'Day 2 is 10 h 25 away from base' is true for the default family profile: 07:40 to 18:05 (Sunshine gondola 08:00 to 11:30, lunch, Minnewanka cruise, pick up the adults at the Sunshine car park at 15:30, Upper Hot Springs 2 h). The timeline also hides the drive back from Minnewanka to Sunshine (the rejoin pin draws no leg), so the real day is about 30 min longer. Owner decision; data not changed.

S2D-TIME. The plan does Braies at first light and Val Fiscalina at 14:00 with a middle of the day at San Candido; the scheduler drives Braies to Fiscalina at 07:45 and waits 5 h 05 there, because a back-to-base leg is only drawn before an evening stop (17:00 or later, timeline.ts doloLegs). The plan time is not wrong; the free-time row is a code behaviour. Owner decision; data not changed.
